clock.requirement: For every downstream capture prove min(data) > propagated clock difference + hold +25ps, and max(data) < T + clock difference - setup -60ps. Zero-delay RTL cannot prove this. No false/multicycle exceptions for the forwarded data path.

reset.warm_reset: Not allowed at station. System must inhibit new issues, drain outstanding credits/results at every endpoint, acknowledge quiescence, then perform coordinated reset/epoch transition. Endpoint drain proof and actual controller binding remain integration gates.
